channel.title: EMMANUELA - Handcrafted Leather Sandals (Portugal)
channel.description: Handcrafted Leather Sandals from Greece - Portugal

item.g:title: Slipper Sandals "Ambrosia" - EU 37
item.g:description: 100% genuine leather Strong grip on wet surfaces thanks to the EVA rubber outsole The sole is approximately 1cm high Leather insole Authentic Greek handmade product - Leather ancient Greek sandals - high-quality slippers Extremely flexible, comfortable & lightweight Whether you are looking for a pair of stylish shoes for your summer holidays or comfortable footwear that will make you stand out every day, these leather sandals & slippers are the perfect choice! The soft leather straps and insoles adapt to the shape of your feet, and the sandals become more comfortable the more you wear them. Emmanuela sandals are handmade in Greece by skilled artisans using traditional techniques that have existed for centuries. The leather, free of synthetic chemicals, changes color evenly over time and with wear. Since the manufacturing methods meet the highest standards and they are made from genuine leather, you can be sure of their maximum comfort and durability! Their EVA rubber non-slip outsoles provide maximum stability on wet surfaces.
item.g:product_highlight: Handcrafted in Greece by skilled artisans
Leather insole that molds to your feet

item.g:title: Men's Lace-up Sandals "Bacchus" - EU 40 / Black
item.g:description: Bacchus — god of wine, celebration, and good times — gives his name to these men's lace-up sandals, made for those who believe summer is meant to be enjoyed. The thin leather laces allow you to adjust the fit as you wish, while the Mediterranean silhouette bridges casual and elegant. Made in Greece from genuine leather, the Bacchus sandals feature a 1.5 cm sole that grips firmly on wet tiles and dry stone. The leather insole softens with wear, and the natural leather darkens beautifully over time — making each pair uniquely yours. Size tip: this design runs smaller than usual — take a look at the size chart and usually choose one size larger than your normal fit. Details Upper: 100% genuine leather Insole: leather Sole: non-slip EVA rubber, 1.5 cm Closure: laces Available in 4 colors: dark brown, black, natural beige, brown Sizes: EU 40–47 Handmade in Greece
item.g:product_highlight: Handcrafted in Greece by skilled artisans

item.g:title: Men's Orthopedic Sandals "Menelaus" - EU 41 / Brown
item.g:description: Menelaos, king of Sparta and leader of armies, was a man who valued durability and endurance. These men's anatomical sandals honor that legacy with a 3 cm elevated sole featuring built-in arch support — serious comfort engineering hidden inside a traditional handmade Greek sandal. Each pair is handmade in Greece from genuine leather, with laces that allow you to adjust the fit. The anatomical leather insole hugs the arch and distributes pressure evenly, making Menelaos ideal for men who demand both comfort and durability. These handmade gladiator sandals carry that enduring quality in their design: a classic woven pattern that has looked beautiful for centuries with no sign of fading. Each pair is made in Greece from genuine leather, with woven straps that hold the foot securely without buckles or laces. The 1 cm sole and leather insole provide quiet, reliable comfort, and five versatile colors blend harmoniously with any wardrobe. Details Upper: 100% genuine leather Insole: leather Sole: non-slip EVA rubber, 1 cm Closure: buckle-free Available in 5 colors: natural beige, white, black, brown, multicolor Sizes: EU 36–42 Handmade in Greece

The Greek meander pattern embossed on the leather strap connects each pair to millennia of Cretan craftsmanship, creating a sandal that is both a handmade work of art and a nod to history. Handmade in Greece from genuine leather, the Crete sandals feature a flat 1 cm sole and a leather insole that molds to the shape of your foot over time. The meander pattern is durable and detailed, maintaining its form throughout the season and beyond. Details Upper: 100% genuine leather with Greek meander pattern Insole: leather Sole: non-slip EVA rubber, 1 cm Closure: slip-on Sizes: EU 36–42 Handmade in Greece

item.g:description: In Greek mythology, Alcestis chose to sacrifice herself for love — a story of devotion and selflessness. These handmade leather sandals celebrate her spirit with cheerful two-tone combinations that bring warmth and energy to every step, from mustard-turquoise to sunny yellow-brown. Each pair is made in Greece from genuine leather, with the two-tone straps carefully matched for harmony. The 1 cm flat sole keeps the Alcestis sandals ultra-light, and the leather insole softens over time for a relaxed, all-day fit. These handmade leather sandals honor that legacy with a palette of six sunny colors — from warm coral to cool turquoise — made for the woman who wants her summer footwear to reflect the vibrancy of the season. Made in Greece from genuine leather, the Zenobia sandals feature a 1 cm flat sole and a leather insole that adapts to the unique shape of your foot. The open design keeps your feet cool, and the sturdy sole handles whatever comes your way — from veranda tiles to sandy trails. The 1 cm flat sole keeps them light, and the leather insole molds to the shape of your foot for easy, all-day comfort. item.g:title: Sandals slippers with meanders "Spetses" - EU 36 / Beige natural
item.g:description: The aristocratic island of Spetses — with its neoclassical mansions and horse-drawn carriages — inspired these leather sandals that combine heritage with modern taste. The Greek meander runs along the strap as a tribute to one of the most enduring symbols of Greek culture, available in five colors from natural to metallic. Handmade in Greece from genuine leather, the Spetses feature a 1 cm flat sole and a smooth leather insole. The meander is embossed on the leather for a lasting detail that elevates a simple sandal into something with cultural resonance. The meander is embossed on the leather for a lasting detail that elevates a simple sandal into something with cultural resonance. item.g:title: Zakynthos sandal slippers - EU 36 / Black
item.g:description: Zakynthos — home of the famous Shipwreck Beach — is an island that balances wild nature with relaxed elegance. These leather sandals follow the same path: a simple cross-strap silhouette in classic colors, perfect everywhere from a beach taverna to a stroll through the old town’s cobblestone streets.
